Avatar.description: a worker's chosen face; null on the worker = not chosen (the screen derives one from the name)

version.description: from REQ-105 on: the LABEL number when the card was cut (0 = no label then)

anchorLabel.description: the label's words when the card was cut (REQ-105); null = none

anchorRemoved.description: true while the card's anchor part is not in Blueprint's spec (REQ-105 D12): the card is not workable and its context answers 404 anchor_removed

stoppedMidway.description: a card back in `todo` after a hop that failed, was stopped or was interrupted: that hop, when it ended, and the leading sentence of its note; null otherwise (SPEC-108 D7)

codeMap.description: the project's code map (v1.16) — null until the entry worker saves one; every card hop knows the folders

handOffTo.description: who the card's worker may hand it to, by name and role

spec.description: Blueprint's v2 part context (SPEC-106 route 2: `revision`, `savedAt`, `latestLabel`, …), exactly as returned — the text the hop was pinned with when `specRead.pinned`

fromCache.description: Blueprint could not be reached and the last body read was served

pinned.description: this is the text the calling hop was given at its start

revision.description: the spec revision `spec` was read at

chatHop.description: the newest chat hop on this message (computed on read)

replyHopId.description: set on an operator message when a hop answers it

retryRequestedAt.description: set when the operator asked for a retry; cleared when the next hop starts on the message

confirmedAt.description: set by the operator's confirm; cleared by every new save

rules.description: may be empty — the screen shows ไม่มี

revision.description: the spec revision the answer was computed on

uncovered.description: sorted by key; empty = every rule is covered

decisions.description: the keys of the uncovered decisions, sorted

key.description: the part the rules are about (a rule that covers nothing is listed under itself)

lastActivityAt.description: startedAt, then the last heartbeat (v1.11); the screen shows how long a running hop has been silent from it

locatedKeys.description: a chat hop: the keys of every locate it made (v1.6); never the spec text

at.description: ISO 8601: when the runner saw the line

seq.description: increasing per hop, not contiguous (a dropped line leaves a hole)

text.description: the rendered, redacted line for `line`; "" for `gap` and `truncated`

allowed.description: handoff_refused only: who the sender could have handed the card to

codeMap.description: null until the entry worker saves one (v1.16)

latestLabel.description: the latest label Blueprint showed: its number and words; null = none (REQ-105)

label.description: its words, or null when Blueprint's label has none (a version from before named labels)

latestSeenVersion.description: the latest label number seen (0 = none)

spec.description: REQ-105: how up to date CAW's view of the spec is

lastPullAt.description: when a pull last got through; null = never

reachable.description: false when the last pull could not reach Blueprint; it catches up on its own when Blueprint is back

revision.description: the spec revision the follower has pulled to (0 = nothing pulled yet)

version.description: from REQ-105 on: the LABEL number when the project started (0 = no label then)

readOnly.description: ⊆ roots; workers read every root and write only the others (D-100)

hopsTotal.description: the sum of the items' hops, computed on read

onBoard.description: REQ-126 r2: indexes of the items whose spec part is already on a live work card of this project, computed on read; [] unless the proposal is open. All of them → accept answers 409 plan_already_accepted; some → accept makes cards for the others only

requirements.description: every `requirement` part of Blueprint's current spec, by key (numeric-aware: REQ-002 before REQ-010); empty = none

revision.description: the spec revision the answer was read at

hopsUsed.description: its finished hops, computed on read

lastSeenAt.description: the last check-in, kept after the team goes quiet

running.description: the last check-in said `running` and is at most 45 s old (a `stopping` check-in makes it false at once)

sessions.description: the runner's open worker sessions (REQ-122); [] when running is false

startCommand.description: what the screen tells the operator to run when running is false

deletedAt.description: set when the operator deleted the worker (v1.14); the list still shows them so history can name them — screens hide them from every picker
